'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Paul Bansal DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bansal]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Leave It To Greivous... OR Maul In The Family'''; username DarkBro. Handwritten. Line 4 '''Insidious Prisoner''' → Insignificant Prisoners; lines 17–19 Galen, Secret Apprentice → Galen Marek, Secret Apprentice; lines 22–23 Battle Droid Squad → Battle Droid; line 26 '''IG Bodyguard Droid''' → IG-88 (uncertain); line 35 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
